entities.rationale: The objects are candidate revision-and-assembly sequences, manuscript features, corrections, physical joins and datings. Manuscript geneticists already treat alternative composition orders and material features as the things under study; naming three sequences as explicit rivals adds no new kind of object.

relations.rationale: Consistency or inconsistency between a feature and a sequence is the ordinary relation a textual scholar argues from (this cancellation presupposes that passage, so this order is impossible). The mapping tabulates that relation for every feature-sequence pair and grades features by how strongly they discriminate, which regularizes rather than replaces the ordinary link.

processes.rationale: The processes of interest remain authorial revision, layering, assembly and material joining of leaves. The mapping does not introduce any new account of how the draft came to be, only a way of comparing accounts of it.

operations.rationale: Comparing witnesses, handwriting, deletions and paper against a proposed order is ordinary. Building an explicit all-features-against-all-sequences matrix, deliberately emphasizing disconfirming features, and re-running the comparison with doubtful datings flipped is a procedural scaffold the scholar would not usually construct as an artefact, but it schedules ordinary comparisons rather than requiring new manipulations of the material.

observables.rationale: Evidence stays exactly the baseline set: draft variants, corrections, physical joins, paper and ink features, dated witnesses and provenance. No new measurement, signal or reader data is introduced.

inferences.rationale: Ruling out a sequence because a feature contradicts it, retaining rival sequences that survive, and stating uncertain intervals rather than a single fixed chronology is already how genetic and stemmatic scholarship licenses conclusions about composition order.

failure_modes.rationale: Missing alternative sequences (lost witnesses), non-independent features (same ink or sitting producing several marks), and subjective reading of corrections are failure modes manuscript scholars already name. Warning that a surviving chronology may still be wrong matches the baseline's acknowledgement of missing witnesses.

rationale: Strip the source vocabulary (inconsistency matrix, diagnosticity, sensitivity testing) and what remains is ordinary manuscript genetics: set out the plausible orders of composition and assembly, check each material and textual feature against each order, give weight to features that rule an order out, see whether the conclusion depends on a doubtful dating, and report which sequences survive with explicit uncertainty. Stemmatic and genetic argument has long worked by elimination of orders that a shared correction or physical join makes impossible. The mapping adds systematic tabulation and explicit disconfirmation emphasis, which is a formalization of the practitioner's existing argumentative moves rather than a reorganization of what they inspect, treat as evidence or conclude. The disciplinary origin in intelligence analysis is irrelevant to that judgment.

epistemic_changes.practitioner_actions: The scholar still examines the same witnesses, handwriting, deletions, insertions and paper features. The one change is procedural: instead of building a narrative case for a preferred sequence and answering objections as they arise, they lay out every feature against all three sequences and revisit the comparison with each doubtful dating assumed wrong.
epistemic_changes.noticed_features: Attention is nudged toward features that contradict at least one sequence and away from features consistent with all three. Manuscript scholars already prize such decisive corrections and joins, so the class of noticed features does not change, though the mapping makes the non-diagnostic status of shared-fit features explicit.
epistemic_changes.evidential_warrants: Warrants are unchanged: a feature counts because of what it materially or textually presupposes about order. The mapping does not admit any new kind of evidence or exclude any ordinary kind; it only asks that each warrant be recorded against every hypothesis rather than only the favoured one.
epistemic_changes.next_inquiry: The next step remains searching for further witnesses, datings or archive context that would decide between surviving sequences. Sensitivity testing may point more explicitly at which doubtful dating most needs resolving, but resolving doubtful datings is already the scholar's ordinary next move.

most_consequential_baseline_difference: The shift from advocating one composition sequence in discursive argument to systematically tabulating every feature against every candidate sequence, with explicit emphasis on contradiction and explicit re-checking under alternative datings. This is a difference in procedure and presentation, not in objects, evidence or licensed conclusions, so it does not amount to displacement.
uncertainty: Baseline scope: the baseline does not state whether the scoped scholar ordinarily keeps several assembly sequences alive as explicit rivals or typically argues for a single preferred sequence; if the latter, the explicit multi-hypothesis matrix is a meaningful extension and Adjacent becomes more defensible.

Baseline scope: whether systematic sensitivity testing under alternative datings is ordinary, rather than occasional hedging, is not settled by the baseline; this is the operation most likely to feel like a foreign apparatus.
The mapping's qualitative weighting of diagnostic contradictions is described only briefly; a more formal scoring scheme would push operations and relations toward level 2.

The scenario is synthetic with hypotheses and features pre-specified, so the difficulty of generating the competing sequences, which is where ordinary scholarly judgment does most of its work, is not exercised by the packet.
